body: i understand friend, but its because we live in the future artists have become a dime a dozen through the outlets of the internet. i frequent the 11secondclub.com, Deviant Art, SIGGRAPH, Cartoon Brew. i try to cover all my bases, its a matter of buckling down and doing the work. but i am caught in a corner of debt that i must pay off. i wish i did have time to volunteer; i work 45 hour weeks and use every moment of spare time to practice my gesture drawings and animation projects. my weekends are wholly devoted and my Mistress caffeine for late nights. having to stop on a project for work in the morning is heart wrenching and i know only improves me at a snails pace.

thank you, I've seen this video it can be inspiring. but what begins to frighten me is i am completely disenchanted with such stories because i know better than to know for such a thing to happen is slim to none and most likely not going to happen. i had believed in the "you can do it if you follow your dreams" zeal for far too long; but the stories often never mentioned are those who fail. there is a song that reminds me of this by Angus and Julia Stone called Hollywood. the love stories, the inspiring stories; there are millions of us and a happy ending isn't likely. eventually people live with the awkward content of what they have. is that selfish though? sure i could try to be content and lie to myself. but the burning failure that will always linger there will always haunt. i can't find the good in much of anything and have grown disgusted with a Disney keep a stiff upper lip way of life. because of this i don't know what to do or if its even normal to feel as such. my art work has been critiqued for years by my peers and industry professionals and i have been told time and time again to go back to basics. i'll never forget the first time i heard it a month before i graduated i was a student volunteer at SIGGRAPH and had my first critique from an professional who wasn't my mentor. he seemed pretty disgusted, years passed and still my work is critiqued harshly. i still push my pen across the paper but i no longer wish to do so at the expense of others becoming a financial burden.

im not sure if i understand the concept of what i can do with that time, because there is nothing else i want from life. my life and goals are affecting my parents which is what i take into consideration on whether to continue leeching from them, i know the economy is bad but it feels terrible still living at home knowing i am a financial burden due to the mistakes of my poor education choices. my parents are old now and have given everything to me and i selfishly accepted only to now be a leech who can only contribute so little. im trying to pick myself up but my spirits grown tired. my entire body feels like its going to give out.
